description: Land Title Settlement Department - Dambagahawela, Siyambalanduwa D/S Division, Monaragala District - Cad. Map No. 720033 and others
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of multiple "NOTICE CALLING FOR CLAIMS TO LAND PARCELS" announcements under the Registration of Title Act. The notices specifically deal with land ownership claims, cadastral maps, land parcels, and title settlement procedures across various districts. This falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) as it primarily concerns land registration, property ownership claims, and land title settlement matters.
